questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

1. The Sixth Schedule is applicable to Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh.

2. It empowers autonomous district councils to make laws on specified subjects.

Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. छठी अनुसूची नागालैंड और अरुणाचल प्रदेश पर लागू है।

2. यह स्वायत्त जिला परिषदों को निर्दिष्ट विषयों पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार देती है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

Key Points

The Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution is applicable only to the four northeastern states: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram. It is **not applicable** to Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh.
Under the Sixth Schedule, **autonomous district councils (ADCs)** are empowered to make laws on specified subjects such as land management, forest resources, and inheritance.
These councils function as local self-governing bodies, and they have the authority to levy taxes, manage public services, and regulate trade within their jurisdiction.
The objective of the Sixth Schedule is to safeguard the rights of tribal communities by granting them autonomy in governance and preserving their cultural heritage.
Statement 1 in the question is incorrect because Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh are governed by **special provisions under Article 371** of the Constitution and are not covered by the Sixth Schedule.
Statement 2 is correct because the Sixth Schedule explicitly empowers ADCs to make laws on certain matters listed in the schedule.

**Additional Information**

**Sixth Schedule:**

It was added to the Constitution through the **Government of India Act, 1935**, and later incorporated into the Constitution in 1950.
The ADCs have legislative, executive, and judicial powers over the subjects listed in the Sixth Schedule, including social customs, land management, forests, and agriculture.
The aim is to protect the rights and autonomy of tribal populations in the northeast.
Each ADC consists of members elected by the people and nominated by the Governor of the respective state.

**Special Provisions for Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh:**

Nagaland is governed under **Article 371A**, which provides special rights to the Naga people over their religion, social practices, and land ownership.
Arunachal Pradesh has special provisions under **Article 371H**, which grants the Governor special powers concerning law and order in the state.
These states are not included in the Sixth Schedule as they have their own unique governance mechanisms.

**Autonomous District Councils (ADCs):**

ADCs are constituted under the Sixth Schedule and function as self-governing bodies for tribal areas.
They have the power to make laws on subjects like land, water resources, and inheritance, but these laws require the approval of the Governor.
They aim to empower tribal communities by giving them control over their local governance.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है।

मुख्य बिंदु

	भारतीय संविधान की छठी अनुसूची केवल चार पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों: असम, मेघालय, त्रिपुरा और मिजोरम पर लागू होती है। यह नागालैंड और अरुणाचल प्रदेश पर **लागू नहीं** होती है।
	छठी अनुसूची के तहत, **स्वायत्त जिला परिषदों (एडीसी)** को भूमि प्रबंधन, वन संसाधनों और विरासत जैसे विशिष्ट विषयों पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार है।
	ये परिषदें स्थानीय स्व-शासी निकायों के रूप में कार्य करती हैं, और उनके पास कर लगाने, सार्वजनिक सेवाओं का प्रबंधन करने और अपने अधिकार क्षेत्र में व्यापार को विनियमित करने का अधिकार है।
	छठी अनुसूची का उद्देश्य आदिवासी समुदायों को शासन में स्वायत्तता प्रदान करके और उनकी सांस्कृतिक विरासत को संरक्षित करके उनके अधिकारों की रक्षा करना है।
	प्रश्न में कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि नागालैंड और अरुणाचल प्रदेश संविधान के **अनुच्छेद 371 के तहत विशेष प्रावधानों** द्वारा शासित हैं और छठी अनुसूची में शामिल नहीं हैं।
	कथन 2 सही है क्योंकि छठी अनुसूची स्पष्ट रूप से एडीसी को अनुसूची में सूचीबद्ध कुछ मामलों पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार देती है।

**अतिरिक्त जानकारी**

	**छठी अनुसूची:**

	
		इसे **भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935** के माध्यम से संविधान में जोड़ा गया था, और बाद में 1950 में संविधान में शामिल किया गया था।
		एडीसी के पास सामाजिक रीति-रिवाजों, भूमि प्रबंधन, जंगलों और कृषि सहित छठी अनुसूची में सूचीबद्ध विषयों पर विधायी, कार्यकारी और न्यायिक शक्तियां हैं।
		इसका उद्देश्य पूर्वोत्तर में आदिवासी आबादी के अधिकारों और स्वायत्तता की रक्षा करना है।
		प्रत्येक एडीसी में लोगों द्वारा चुने गए और संबंधित राज्य के राज्यपाल द्वारा नामित सदस्य होते हैं।
	
	
	**नागालैंड और अरुणाचल प्रदेश के लिए विशेष प्रावधान:**
	
		नागालैंड **अनुच्छेद 371A** के तहत शासित है, जो नागा लोगों को उनके धर्म, सामाजिक प्रथाओं और भूमि स्वामित्व पर विशेष अधिकार प्रदान करता है।
		अरुणाचल प्रदेश में **अनुच्छेद 371H** के तहत विशेष प्रावधान हैं, जो राज्यपाल को राज्य में कानून और व्यवस्था के संबंध में विशेष अधिकार प्रदान करते हैं।
		इन राज्यों को छठी अनुसूची में शामिल नहीं किया गया है क्योंकि उनके पास अपनी अनूठी शासन व्यवस्था है।
	
	
	**स्वायत्त जिला परिषदें (एडीसी):**
	
		एडीसी का गठन छठी अनुसूची के तहत किया जाता है और आदिवासी क्षेत्रों के लिए स्व-शासी निकायों के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
		उनके पास भूमि, जल संसाधनों और विरासत जैसे विषयों पर कानून बनाने की शक्ति है, लेकिन इन कानूनों को राज्यपाल की मंजूरी की आवश्यकता होती है।
		उनका उद्देश्य आदिवासी समुदायों को उनके स्थानीय शासन पर नियंत्रण देकर सशक्त बनाना है।

questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST):

1. It observes in the near-infrared and mid-infrared spectrum.

2. It is positioned at the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point L2.

3. It carries a coronagraph for exoplanet detection.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
जेम्स वेब स्पेस टेलीस्कोप (JWST) के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. यह निकट-अवरक्त और मध्य-अवरक्त स्पेक्ट्रम में प्रेक्षण करता है।

2. यह सूर्य-पृथ्वी लैग्रेंज बिंदु L2 पर स्थित है।

3. इसमें बाह्यग्रहों का पता लगाने के लिए एक कोरोनोग्राफ लगा है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से **सही है/हैं**?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

Key Points

The **James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)** observes primarily in the **near-infrared and mid-infrared spectrum**, enabling it to peer through cosmic dust and study distant galaxies, stars, and planetary systems.
It is positioned at the **Sun-Earth Lagrange Point L2**, approximately 1.5 million kilometers away from Earth, providing a stable environment for its operations while keeping it shielded from solar and terrestrial radiation.
The JWST is equipped with a **coronagraph**, a device designed to block light from a star to allow the observation of faint objects like exoplanets orbiting it.
Launched on **December 25, 2021**, by NASA, in collaboration with ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency), the JWST is the most advanced space telescope to date, designed to succeed the Hubble Space Telescope.
The JWST aims to explore fundamental questions about the formation of stars and galaxies, the atmospheres of exoplanets, and the origins of the universe.

**Additional Information**

**Lagrange Point L2:**

The Lagrange Point L2 is a gravitationally stable location behind Earth, where the combined gravitational forces of the Sun and Earth allow an object to remain in a fixed position relative to them.

**JWST:**

The JWST's primary mirror is 6.5 meters in diameter, significantly larger than Hubble's 2.4-meter mirror, enhancing its light-gathering capabilities.
The telescope operates at extremely low temperatures, around -233°C, to ensure optimal performance of its infrared instruments.
Its sunshield, the size of a tennis court, protects the telescope from solar radiation and helps maintain its operational temperature.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है।

मुख्य बिंदु

	**जेम्स वेब स्पेस टेलीस्कोप (JWST)** मुख्य रूप से **निकट-अवरक्त और मध्य-अवरक्त स्पेक्ट्रम** में अवलोकन करता है, जिससे यह ब्रह्मांडीय धूल के माध्यम से देखने और दूर की आकाशगंगाओं, तारों और ग्रहों की प्रणालियों का अध्ययन करने में सक्षम होता है।
	यह **सूर्य-पृथ्वी लैग्रेंज बिंदु L2** पर स्थित है, जो पृथ्वी से लगभग 1.5 मिलियन किलोमीटर दूर है, जो इसके संचालन के लिए एक स्थिर वातावरण प्रदान करता है और इसे सौर और स्थलीय विकिरण से सुरक्षित रखता है।
	JWST एक **कोरोनाग्राफ** से लैस है, जो एक तारे से प्रकाश को अवरुद्ध करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया एक उपकरण है ताकि उसके चारों ओर घूमने वाले एक्सोप्लैनेट जैसी धुंधली वस्तुओं का अवलोकन किया जा सके।
	**25 दिसंबर, 2021** को NASA द्वारा ESA (यूरोपीय अंतरिक्ष एजेंसी) और CSA (कनाडाई अंतरिक्ष एजेंसी) के सहयोग से लॉन्च किया गया, JWST आज तक का सबसे उन्नत अंतरिक्ष दूरबीन है, जिसे हबल स्पेस टेलीस्कोप के बाद बनाया गया है।
	JWST का उद्देश्य तारों और आकाशगंगाओं के निर्माण, एक्सोप्लैनेट के वायुमंडल और ब्रह्मांड की उत्पत्ति के बारे में मूलभूत प्रश्नों का पता लगाना है।

**अतिरिक्त जानकारी**

	**लैग्रेंज बिंदु L2:**

	
		लैग्रेंज बिंदु L2 पृथ्वी के पीछे एक गुरुत्वाकर्षण रूप से स्थिर स्थान है, जहाँ सूर्य और पृथ्वी के संयुक्त गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल किसी वस्तु को उनके सापेक्ष एक निश्चित स्थिति में रहने की अनुमति देते हैं।
	
	
	**JWST:**
	
		JWST का प्राथमिक दर्पण 6.5 मीटर व्यास का है, जो हबल के 2.4 मीटर दर्पण से काफी बड़ा है, जो इसकी प्रकाश-संग्रहण क्षमताओं को बढ़ाता है।
		दूरबीन बेहद कम तापमान, लगभग -233°C पर काम करती है, ताकि इसके अवरक्त उपकरणों का इष्टतम प्रदर्शन सुनिश्चित किया जा सके।
		इसका सनशील्ड, जो टेनिस कोर्ट के आकार का है, दूरबीन को सौर विकिरण से बचाता है और इसके परिचालन तापमान को बनाए रखने में मदद करता है।

questions.questionText: Simplify: \(\sqrt{(12+6\sqrt{3) }} \)
questions.questionTextHi: सरल कीजिए: \(\sqrt{(12+6\sqrt{3) }} \)
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
In surd square roots √(A + B), split B into 2 × a × b.

Here, 6√3 = 2 × 3 × √3. Let a = 3 and b = √3.

Check if a2 + b2 = A ⇒ 32 + (√3)2 = 9 + 3 = 12. This matches perfectly!

So, the expression is exactly (a + b)2 = (3 + √3)2.

Taking the square root cancels the square, giving 3 + √3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 + √3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

√(12 + 6√3)

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us express the term inside the square root in the form of a perfect square.

⇒ The given expression is 12 + 6√3.

⇒ We can rewrite the middle term 6√3 as 2 × 3 × √3.

⇒ This implies a = 3 and b = √3 in the identity (a + b)2.

⇒ Now, let us check a2 + b2: 32 + (√3)2 = 9 + 3 = 12.

⇒ So, 12 + 6√3 can be written as 32 + (√3)2 + 2 × 3 × √3.

⇒ This perfectly matches the expansion of (3 + √3)2.

⇒ Therefore, √(12 + 6√3) = √((3 + √3)2).

⇒ The square root and square cancel each other out.

⇒ Simplification gives 3 + √3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 + √3.**

**Additional Information**

Square Root of Surds

To find the square root of a mixed surd A + √B, assume it equals √x + √y. Squaring both sides gives A + √B = x + y + 2√(xy). Then equate rational and irrational parts to solve for x and y.

Algebraic Identities

The identities (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab and (a − b)2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab are crucial. If the given expression was √(12 − 6√3), the simplified answer would be 3 − √3.

Conjugate Surds

When surds appear in the denominator, multiply both numerator and denominator by the conjugate (changing the middle sign) to rationalise it: 1 ÷ (a + √b) × (a − √b) ÷ (a − √b).

⇒ तो, 12 + 6√3 को 32 + (√3)2 + 2 × 3 × √3 के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है।

⇒ यह (3 + √3)2 के विस्तार से पूरी तरह मेल खाता है।

⇒ इसलिए, √(12 + 6√3) = √((3 + √3)2)।

⇒ वर्गमूल और वर्ग एक दूसरे को रद्द कर देते हैं।

⇒ सरलीकरण से 3 + √3 मिलता है।

**∴ सही उत्तर 3 + √3 है।**

करणी का वर्गमूल

मिश्रित करणी A + √B का वर्गमूल ज्ञात करने के लिए, मान लें कि यह √x + √y के बराबर है। दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर A + √B = x + y + 2√(xy) प्राप्त होता है। फिर x और y को हल करने के लिए परिमेय और अपरिमेय भागों को बराबर करें।

बीजगणितीय सर्वसमिकाएँ

सर्वसमिकाएँ (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab और (a − b)2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab महत्वपूर्ण हैं। यदि दिया गया व्यंजक √(12 − 6√3) था, तो सरलीकृत उत्तर 3 − √3 होगा।

संयुग्मी करणी

जब हर में करणी दिखाई देती है, तो इसे परिमेय बनाने के लिए अंश और हर दोनों को संयुग्मी (बीच के चिह्न को बदलकर) से गुणा करें: 1 ÷ (a + √b) × (a − √b) ÷ (a − √b)।

questions.questionText: Given that W : X = 5 : 6, X : Y = 3 : 7, and Y : Z = 8 : 9, find the compound ratio W : X : Y : Z.
questions.questionTextHi: दिया गया है कि W : X = 5 : 6, X : Y = 3 : 7, तथा Y : Z = 8 : 9 है, तो यौगिक अनुपात W : X : Y : Z ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Using the shift method or blank space filling technique:

W : X : Y : Z = (5 × 3 × 8) : (6 × 3 × 8) : (6 × 7 × 8) : (6 × 7 × 9)

W : X : Y : Z = 120 : 144 : 336 : 378

Simplifying by dividing all ratio terms by their HCF, which is 6:

W : X : Y : Z = 20 : 24 : 56 : 63

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 24 : 56 : 63.**

**Alternate Method**

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, equate the common term X in the first two ratios by making them equal to the LCM of 6 and 3.

⇒ W : X = 5 : 6

⇒ X : Y = 3 : 7 = (3 × 2) : (7 × 2) = 6 : 14

⇒ Combining W, X, and Y gives W : X : Y = 5 : 6 : 14

⇒ Now, equate the common term Y with the third ratio using the LCM of 14 and 8, which is 56.

⇒ Y : Z = 8 : 9

⇒ W : X : Y = (5 × 4) : (6 × 4) : (14 × 4) = 20 : 24 : 56

⇒ Y : Z = (8 × 7) : (9 × 7) = 56 : 63

⇒ By combining all four variables, we obtain W : X : Y : Z = 20 : 24 : 56 : 63

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 24 : 56 : 63.**

**Additional Information**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, it is known as a compound ratio. For ratios a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is ac : bd.

Duplicate and Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is determined as a2 : b2, whereas its sub-duplicate ratio is expressed as √a : √b.

Proportionality Rule

If four numbers a, b, c, d are in a perfect proportion (a : b :: c : d), then the product of extremes is always equal to the product of means (ad = bc).

questions.questionText: What is the value of \(\sqrt{6+\sqrt{6+\sqrt{6+\dots}}} \)
questions.questionTextHi: \(\sqrt{6+\sqrt{6+\sqrt{6+\dots}}} \) का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick

For an infinite series of the form √(a + √(a + √(a + ...))), we find two consecutive integers whose product is a.

Here, a = 6, which can be factored into consecutive integers as 2 × 3.

Since the series has a positive (+) sign throughout, the answer will be the larger integer.

The larger integer between 2 and 3 is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

The infinite nested radical expression is √(6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞)))

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let x = √(6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞)))

⇒ Squaring both sides of the equation, we get:

⇒ x2 = 6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞))

⇒ Since the expression goes to infinity, the repeating part is equal to x:

⇒ x2 = 6 + x

⇒ x2 − x − 6 = 0

⇒ x2 − 3x + 2x − 6 = 0

⇒ x(x − 3) + 2(x − 3) = 0

⇒ (x − 3)(x + 2) = 0

⇒ x = 3 or x = −2

⇒ Since the value of a positive square root cannot be negative, we take x = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Additional Information**

Negative Infinite Nested Radical

For a series √(a − √(a − √(a − ...))), if a can be written as the product of two consecutive integers, the answer is the smaller integer. Example: √(6 − √(6 − ...)) = 2.

Multiplicative Infinite Nested Radical

For an infinite series under multiplication like √(a × √(a × √(a × ...))), the final value evaluates exactly to a. Example: √(6 × √(6 × ...)) = 6.

Non-Factorable Infinite Radical

If the term a cannot be factored into two consecutive integers, the exact value of √(a + √(a + ...)) is found using the direct formula (√(4a + 1) + 1) ÷ 2.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick

√(a + √(a + √(a + ...))) के रूप की एक अनंत श्रेणी के लिए, हम दो क्रमागत पूर्णांक ज्ञात करते हैं जिनका गुणनफल a होता है।

यहाँ, a = 6, जिसे क्रमागत पूर्णांकों के रूप में 2 × 3 में गुणनखंडित किया जा सकता है।

चूँकि श्रेणी में पूरी तरह से धनात्मक (+) चिह्न है, इसलिए उत्तर बड़ा पूर्णांक होगा।

2 और 3 के बीच बड़ा पूर्णांक 3 है।

**∴ सही उत्तर 3 है। **

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है: **

अनंत अंतर्निहित करणी व्यंजक √(6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞))) है

**गणना: **

⇒ मान लीजिए x = √(6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞)))

⇒ समीकरण के दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर, हमें प्राप्त होता है:

⇒ x2 = 6 + √(6 + √(6 + ...∞))

⇒ चूँकि व्यंजक अनंत तक जाता है, इसलिए दोहराया गया भाग x के बराबर है:

⇒ x2 = 6 + x

⇒ x2 − x − 6 = 0

⇒ x2 − 3x + 2x − 6 = 0

⇒ x(x − 3) + 2(x − 3) = 0

⇒ (x − 3)(x + 2) = 0

⇒ x = 3 या x = −2

⇒ चूँकि एक धनात्मक वर्गमूल का मान ऋणात्मक नहीं हो सकता है, इसलिए हम x = 3 लेते हैं।

**∴ सही उत्तर 3 है। **

**Additional Information**

Negative Infinite Nested Radical

√(a − √(a − √(a − ...))) श्रेणी के लिए, यदि a को दो क्रमागत पूर्णांकों के गुणनफल के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है, तो उत्तर छोटा पूर्णांक होता है। उदाहरण: √(6 − √(6 − ...)) = 2।

Multiplicative Infinite Nested Radical

गुणा जैसे √(a x √(a x √(a x ...))) के तहत एक अनंत श्रेणी के लिए, अंतिम मान बिल्कुल a के बराबर होता है। उदाहरण: √(6 x √(6 x ...)) = 6।

Non-Factorable Infinite Radical

यदि पद a को दो क्रमागत पूर्णांकों में गुणनखंडित नहीं किया जा सकता है, तो √(a + √(a + ...)) का सटीक मान सीधे सूत्र (√(4a + 1) + 1) ÷ 2 का उपयोग करके पाया जाता है।

questions.questionText: A vendor purchases 7 shirts at the marked price of 6 shirts. If he sells each shirt after giving a 4% discount on its marked price, what is his profit percentage?
questions.questionTextHi: एक विक्रेता 6 शर्ट के अंकित मूल्य पर 7 शर्ट खरीदता है। यदि वह प्रत्येक शर्ट को उसके अंकित मूल्य पर 4% की छूट देकर बेचता है, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Let the Marked Price (MP) of 1 shirt be 100.

Total Cost Price (CP) for 7 shirts = MP of 6 shirts = 600.

Total Selling Price (SP) for 7 shirts after 4% discount = 7 × 96 = 672.

Profit = SP − CP = 672 − 600 = 72.

Profit % = (72 ÷ 600) × 100 = 12%.

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Number of shirts purchased = 7

Cost Price of 7 shirts = Marked Price of 6 shirts

Discount on Marked Price = 4%

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) − Discount

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the Marked Price (MP) of 1 shirt be ₹100.

⇒ MP of 7 shirts = 7 × 100 = ₹700

⇒ Total CP of 7 shirts = MP of 6 shirts = 6 × 100 = ₹600

⇒ Discount applied on each shirt = 4% of ₹100 = ₹4

⇒ Selling Price (SP) of 1 shirt = 100 − 4 = ₹96

⇒ Total SP of 7 shirts = 7 × 96 = ₹672

⇒ Profit earned = SP − CP = 672 − 600 = ₹72

⇒ Profit % = (72 ÷ 600) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 12%

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

**Additional Information**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is an allowance given to the buyer and is strictly calculated on the Marked Price (MP), not the Cost Price (CP).
Formula: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Profit & Loss Basics

Profit and Loss percentages indicate the financial gain or loss relative to the cost. Both are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise.
Formula: Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Markup Percentage

Markup is the additional percentage by which the Cost Price is increased to set the Marked Price (label price) of an item.
Formula: MP = CP × (100 + Markup%) ÷ 100

questions.questionText: Pipe A is capable of filling a tank in 16 minutes while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 24 minutes. Both pipes are opened together, but after 4 minutes, the rate of Pipe A doubles and the rate of Pipe B becomes half of its original. How many more minutes will it take to fill the tank completely?
questions.questionTextHi: पाइप A एक टैंक को 16 मिनट में भर सकता है जबकि पाइप B उस टैंक को 24 मिनट में भर सकता है। दोनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं, लेकिन 4 मिनट के बाद, पाइप A की दर दोगुनी हो जाती है और पाइप B की दर अपनी मूल दर से आधी हो जाती है। टैंक को पूर्णतः भरने में कितने अतिरिक्त मिनट लगेंगे?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Total capacity = LCM(16, 24) = 48 units.

Initial efficiency: A = 3 units/min, B = 2 units/min ⇒ Total = 5 units/min.

Work completed in 4 mins = 5 × 4 = 20 units ⇒ Remaining = 48 − 20 = 28 units.

New efficiency: A = 6 (doubled), B = 1 (halved) ⇒ New total = 7 units/min.

Time for remaining work = 28 ÷ 7 = 4 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 min.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A = 16 minutes

Time taken by Pipe B = 24 minutes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial combined efficiency of A and B = 3 + 2 = 5 units/min

⇒ Work completed by both pipes in the first 4 minutes = 5 × 4 = 20 units

⇒ Remaining work to be done = 48 − 20 = 28 units

⇒ After 4 minutes, the rate of Pipe A doubles ⇒ New efficiency of A = 3 × 2 = 6 units/min

⇒ Rate of Pipe B becomes half ⇒ New efficiency of B = 2 ÷ 2 = 1 unit/min

⇒ New combined efficiency of both pipes = 6 + 1 = 7 units/min

⇒ Time required to complete the remaining work = Remaining work ÷ New combined efficiency

⇒ Time required = 28 ÷ 7 = 4 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 4 min.**

**Additional Information**

Inlet vs Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank (taken as positive efficiency), while an outlet pipe or leak empties it (taken as negative efficiency). Net efficiency is the algebraic sum of all operating pipes.

Proportional Efficiency

The efficiency of a pipe is inversely proportional to the time it takes to fill the tank independently. If a pipe's efficiency is doubled, the time it takes to do the same work is halved.

Varying Efficiencies

Whenever efficiency changes mid-way, always calculate the exact total work completed using the old efficiency first, and then apply the new efficiency strictly to the remaining units of work.

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Given a + b = 5 and ab = 6, we can deduce the values are a = 3 and b = 2.

Substitute these directly into (a3 + b3)2 − 9a2b2(a + b)2:

⇒ (33 + 23)2 − 9(3 × 2)2(3 + 2)2 ⇒ (27 + 8)2 − 9(36)(25)

⇒ (35)2 − 8100 ⇒ 1225 − 8100 = -6875

**∴ The correct answer is -6875.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

a + b = 5

ab = 6

**Formula Used:**

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 − 3ab(a + b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a3 + b3 = (5)3 − 3 × 6 × 5

⇒ a3 + b3 = 125 − 90 = 35

Now, substitute the required values into the given expression:

⇒ (a3 + b3)2 − 9a2b2(a + b)2

⇒ (35)2 − 9 × (ab)2 × (a + b)2

⇒ 1225 − 9 × (6)2 × (5)2

⇒ 1225 − 9 × 36 × 25

⇒ 1225 − 8100

⇒ -6875

**∴ The correct answer is -6875.**

**Additional Information**

Sum of Cubes Formula

The sum of cubes can be factored as a3 + b3 = (a + b)(a2 − ab + b2) or expressed as (a + b)3 − 3ab(a + b).

Difference of Cubes Formula

Similarly, the difference of cubes is given by a3 − b3 = (a − b)(a2 + ab + b2) or (a − b)3 + 3ab(a − b).

Square of a Sum Formula

The expansion for the square of a sum is (a + b)2 = a2 + 2ab + b2, which is frequently used to find sums of squares: a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 − 2ab.

questions.questionText: A sum of ₹10000 is lent out in two parts, one at 7% simple interest and the other at 12% simple interest. If the annual interest is ₹900, the sum lent at 12% is:
questions.questionTextHi: ₹10000 की राशि दो भागों में उधार दी जाती है, एक 7% साधारण ब्याज पर और दूसरा 12% साधारण ब्याज पर। यदि वार्षिक ब्याज ₹900 है, तो 12% पर उधार दी गई राशि है:
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
If the entire sum of ₹10000 was lent at 7%, the interest would be 7% of 10000 = ₹700.

Extra interest received = ₹900 − ₹700 = ₹200.

This extra interest is purely due to the additional 5% (12% − 7%) on the second part.

⇒ 5% of the sum at 12% = ₹200

⇒ Sum at 12% = (200 × 100) ÷ 5 = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Total sum = ₹10000

Total annual interest = ₹900

**Formula Used:**

Overall Rate (R) = (Total Interest × 100) ÷ (Principal × Time)

Part 1 (7%)

Part 2 (12%)

Mean (9%)

12 − 9 = 3

9 − 7 = 2

Ratio of Parts = 3 : 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Overall rate of interest = (900 × 100) ÷ (10000 × 1) = 9%

⇒ By rule of alligation, ratio of sum lent at 7% to sum lent at 12% = 3 : 2

⇒ Total ratio parts = 3 + 2 = 5 parts

⇒ Value of 5 parts = ₹10000

⇒ Value of 1 part = 10000 ÷ 5 = ₹2000

⇒ Sum lent at 12% (2 parts) = 2 × 2000 = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**Additional Information**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated only on the principal amount, while Compound Interest is calculated on the principal and the accumulated interest of previous periods.

Rule of Alligation

When two ingredients or parts are mixed, the ratio in which they are distributed is given by: (Quantity of cheaper) / (Quantity of dearer) = (Price of dearer − Mean price) / (Mean price − Price of cheaper).

Effective Rate of Interest

The effective interest rate is the total interest generated over a year expressed as a percentage of the total principal. Formula: R = (Total SI × 100) / (Total Principal × Time).
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
यदि ₹10000 की पूरी राशि 7% पर उधार दी जाती, तो ब्याज 10000 का 7% = ₹700 होता।

प्राप्त अतिरिक्त ब्याज = ₹900 − ₹700 = ₹200।

यह अतिरिक्त ब्याज विशुद्ध रूप से दूसरे भाग पर अतिरिक्त 5% (12% − 7%) के कारण है।

⇒ 12% पर राशि का 5% = ₹200

⇒ 12% पर राशि = (200 x 100) ÷ 5 = ₹4000

**∴ सही उत्तर ₹4000 है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

कुल राशि = ₹10000

कुल वार्षिक ब्याज = ₹900

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

समग्र दर (R) = (कुल ब्याज x 100) ÷ (मूलधन x समय)

  
  भाग 1 (7%)
  
  
  भाग 2 (12%)
  
  
  माध्य (9%)

  
  
  
  
  

  
  12 − 9 = 3
  
  
  9 − 7 = 2
  
  भागों का अनुपात = 3 : 2

**गणना:**

⇒ ब्याज की समग्र दर = (900 x 100) ÷ (10000 x 1) = 9%

⇒ मिश्रण के नियम से, 7% पर उधार दी गई राशि और 12% पर उधार दी गई राशि का अनुपात = 3 : 2

⇒ कुल अनुपात के भाग = 3 + 2 = 5 भाग

⇒ 5 भागों का मान = ₹10000

⇒ 1 भाग का मान = 10000 ÷ 5 = ₹2000

⇒ 12% पर उधार दी गई राशि (2 भाग) = 2 x 2000 = ₹4000

**∴ सही उत्तर ₹4000 है।**

**Additional Information**

साधारण ब्याज बनाम चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज

साधारण ब्याज की गणना केवल मूलधन पर की जाती है, जबकि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की गणना मूलधन और पिछली अवधियों के संचित ब्याज पर की जाती है।

मिश्रण का नियम

जब दो घटकों या भागों को मिलाया जाता है, तो वे जिस अनुपात में वितरित होते हैं, वह इस प्रकार दिया जाता है: (सस्ते की मात्रा) / (महंगे की मात्रा) = (महंगे का मूल्य − औसत मूल्य) / (औसत मूल्य − सस्ते का मूल्य)।

ब्याज की प्रभावी दर

प्रभावी ब्याज दर एक वर्ष में उत्पन्न कुल ब्याज है जिसे कुल मूलधन के प्रतिशत के रूप में व्यक्त किया जाता है। सूत्र: R = (कुल SI x 100) / (कुल मूलधन x समय)।

questions.questionText: Rs. 900 is lent at a certain rate of simple interest. After 9 months, another Rs. 600 is lent at a rate that is 1.5 times the original rate. If the total simple interest after 1 year is Rs. 72, find the original rate.
questions.questionTextHi: 900 रुपये साधारण ब्याज की एक निश्चित दर पर उधार दिए जाते हैं। 9 माह बाद, 600 रुपये मूल ब्याज की 1.5 गुना दर पर उधार दिए जाते हैं। यदि 1 वर्ष के बाद कुल साधारण ब्याज 72 रुपये है, तो मूल ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

**Official Commission Key & Solution:**

The correct answer is **Option 1**: "6.4%".

questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
दूसरे मूलधन को सामान्य करके 1 वर्ष के लिए R% की दर पर प्रभावी मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।

प्रभावी P = P1 + P2 x (दर गुणक) x (वर्षों में समय)

प्रभावी P = 900 + 600 x 1.5 x (3 ÷ 12) = 900 + 225 = 1125

अब, साधारण ब्याज सूत्र लागू करें: (1125 x R x 1) ÷ 100 = 72

⇒ R = 7200 ÷ 1125 = 6.4%

**∴ सही उत्तर 6.4% है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

⇒ पहला मूलधन (P1) = ₹900, दर (R1) = R%

⇒ P1 के लिए कुल समय = 1 वर्ष = 12 महीने

⇒ दूसरा मूलधन (P2) = ₹600, दर (R2) = 1.5R%

⇒ दूसरी राशि के लिए समय (T2) = 12 − 9 = 3 महीने = 1/4 वर्ष

⇒ कुल साधारण ब्याज = ₹72

  
  
  
  
  
  0 महीने
  9 महीने
  12 महीने
  ₹900, 12 महीने के लिए R% की दर से
  ₹600, 1.5R% की दर से
  3 महीने के लिए
  कुल ब्याज = ₹72

**गणना:**

⇒ साधारण ब्याज का सूत्र = (P x R x T) ÷ 100

⇒ P1 से साधारण ब्याज = (900 x R x 1) ÷ 100 = 9R

⇒ P2 से साधारण ब्याज = (600 x 1.5R x 0.25) ÷ 100 = (600 x 1.5R x 1) ÷ 400

⇒ P2 से साधारण ब्याज = 150 x 1.5R ÷ 100 = 2.25R

⇒ कुल साधारण ब्याज = P1 से साधारण ब्याज + P2 से साधारण ब्याज

⇒ 9R + 2.25R = 72

⇒ 11.25R = 72

⇒ R = 72 ÷ 11.25

⇒ R = 7200 ÷ 1125 = 6.4

**∴ सही उत्तर 6.4% है।**

**Additional Information**

साधारण ब्याज का सूत्र

साधारण ब्याज (SI) की गणना हमेशा I = (P x R x T) ÷ 100 का उपयोग करके प्रारंभिक मूलधन पर की जाती है, जहाँ P मूलधन है, R ब्याज दर है, और T वर्षों में समय है।

प्रभावी मूलधन अवधारणा

जब विभिन्न दरों और समय अवधियों पर कई निवेश किए जाते हैं, तो उन्हें आधार दर पर एकल समतुल्य मूलधन में मिलाया जा सकता है: प्रभावी P = Σ(Pi x समय कारक x दर गुणक)।

राशि सूत्र

दी गई अवधि के बाद कुल संचित राशि (A) केवल अर्जित कुल ब्याज के साथ मूलधन है: A = P + I।

questions.questionText: A flagpole has a shadow measuring 10 meters. Given that the height of the flagpole is 10√3 meters, What is the angle at which the sun is elevated?
questions.questionTextHi: एक ध्वजदंड की छाया 10 मीटर लंबी है। यदि ध्वजदंड की ऊँचाई 10√3 मीटर है, तो सूर्य किस कोण पर ऊपर की ओर स्थित है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The tangent of the angle of elevation (θ) is the ratio of the flagpole's height to the shadow's length.

⇒ tan(θ) = 10√3 ÷ 10

⇒ tan(θ) = √3

Since tan(60°) = √3, the angle of elevation of the sun is 60°.

**∴ The correct answer is 60°.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

⇒ Height of the flagpole (AB) = 10√3 m

⇒ Length of the shadow (BC) = 10 m

**Formula Used:**

⇒ tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

Let the angle of elevation of the sun be θ (angle ACB).

In the right-angled ΔABC:

⇒ tan(θ) = AB ÷ BC

⇒ tan(θ) = 10√3 ÷ 10

⇒ tan(θ) = √3

We know from the standard trigonometric table that tan(60°) = √3.

⇒ θ = 60°

**∴ The correct answer is 60°.**

**Additional Information**

Trigonometric Tangent Ratio

In a right-angled triangle, the tangent function relates the opposite side to the adjacent side: tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base. It is fundamentally used to solve unknown heights and distances without calculating the hypotenuse.

Angle of Elevation vs Angle of Depression

The angle of elevation is the angle formed by the line of sight when looking upwards from the horizontal. Conversely, the angle of depression is formed when looking downwards. In height problems involving a single object and observer, both angles are geometrically equal due to alternate interior angles.

Standard Values of Tangent

It is highly beneficial to memorize standard tangent values for quick problem-solving: tan(30°) = 1÷√3, tan(45°) = 1, and tan(60°) = √3.

questions.questionTextHi: एक खोखले धातु के गोले की बाह्य त्रिज्या 10 सेमी है और इसे पिघलाकर 2 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले 50 छोटे ठोस गोले बनाए जाते हैं। मूल गोले की आंतरिक त्रिज्या क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
When melting and recasting spheres, the constant terms (like (4/3) × π) cancel out.

Equate the effective volumes directly: R3 − r3 = n × rsmall3

103 − r3 = 50 × 23

1000 − r3 = 400 ⇒ r3 = 600

r = 3√600 ≈ 8.43 cm (Since 83 = 512 and 93 = 729)

**∴ The correct answer is 8.43 cm.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Outer radius of the hollow sphere (R) = 10 cm

Radius of smaller solid spheres (rsmall) = 2 cm

Number of smaller spheres (n) = 50

**Formula Used:**

Volume of solid sphere = (4/3) × π × r3

**Calculations:**

Let the inner radius of the hollow sphere be r.

⇒ Volume of hollow sphere = Volume of 50 solid spheres

⇒ (4/3) × π × (103 − r3) = 50 × (4/3) × π × 23

⇒ Cancelling (4/3) × π from both sides:

⇒ 1000 − r3 = 50 × 8

⇒ 1000 − r3 = 400

⇒ r3 = 1000 − 400

⇒ r3 = 600

⇒ r = 3√600 ≈ 8.434 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8.43 cm.**

**Additional Information**

Principle of Melting and Recasting

When a 3D object is melted and recast into another shape, the total volume of the material remains constant. Volumeinitial = Volumefinal.

Volume and Surface Area of a Solid Sphere

questions.questionText: The volume of a hemisphere is numerically equal to four times its curved surface area. Find its radius.
questions.questionTextHi: एक अर्धगोले का आयतन संख्यात्मक रूप से उसके वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के चार गुना के बराबर है। इसकी त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The ratio of Volume to Curved Surface Area of a hemisphere is [(2/3)πr3] ÷ [2πr2] = r / 3.

Given that Volume = 4 × CSA, we can write the ratio as 4.

⇒ r / 3 = 4

⇒ r = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**Alternate Method**

r
Volume (V) = 2/3 × π × r³
Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r²

**Given:**

Volume of the hemisphere = 4 × Curved Surface Area of the hemisphere

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = 2/3 × πr3

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere = 2πr2

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the hemisphere be r cm.

According to the given condition:

⇒ 2/3 × πr3 = 4 × (2πr2)

⇒ 2/3 × πr3 = 8πr2

Dividing both sides by πr2:

⇒ 2/3 × r = 8

⇒ r = 8 × (3 / 2)

⇒ r = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**Additional Information**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

It includes the curved surface area and the flat circular base area. Formula: TSA = 3πr2.

Volume of a Sphere

A complete sphere has exactly twice the volume of a hemisphere of the same radius. Formula: V = (4/3)πr3.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total curved surface of a complete sphere is four times the area of its great circle. Formula: SA = 4πr2.

questions.questionText: What is the minimum number of cuts required to divide a cuboid into 8 equal cuboids?
questions.questionTextHi: एक आयताकार घनाभ को 8 समान घनाभों में बाँटने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने कटाव की आवश्यकता होगी?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Total pieces formed by making cuts along three perpendicular axes is (x + 1)(y + 1)(z + 1) = 8.

To minimize total cuts (x + y + z), the factors must be as close to each other as possible.

The closest integer factors for 8 are 2 × 2 × 2.

Thus, x + 1 = 2 ⇒ x = 1, y = 1, and z = 1.

Total minimum cuts = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 cuts.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 cuts.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

A cuboid is to be divided into 8 equal cuboids.

**Formula Used:**

Number of pieces = (x + 1) × (y + 1) × (z + 1)

Where x, y, and z are the number of cuts along the length, breadth, and height respectively.

3 Cuts = 8 Equal Cuboids

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total pieces required = 8

⇒ (x + 1) × (y + 1) × (z + 1) = 8

⇒ To find the minimum number of cuts (x + y + z), we must express 8 as the product of three integers as close to each other as possible.

⇒ Let us evaluate the possible combinations for factors of 8:

⇒ Case 1: 8 × 1 × 1 → x = 7, y = 0, z = 0 → Total cuts = 7 + 0 + 0 = 7

⇒ Case 2: 4 × 2 × 1 → x = 3, y = 1, z = 0 → Total cuts = 3 + 1 + 0 = 4

⇒ Case 3: 2 × 2 × 2 → x = 1, y = 1, z = 1 → Total cuts = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3

⇒ The absolute minimum number of total cuts is obtained in Case 3.

⇒ Minimum cuts = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 cuts.**

**Additional Information**

Maximum Pieces with N cuts

To maximize pieces for a given number of total cuts N, distribute the cuts equally among the three dimensions so that x ≈ y ≈ z ≈ N ÷ 3.

Total Painted Faces in a Cut Cube

If a fully painted larger cube is cut into n3 identical smaller cubes, the number of smaller cubes with exactly 3 painted faces is always 8 (located at the corners).

Zero Face Painted Cubes

The number of completely unpainted internal identical cubes is determined using the formula (n − 2)3, where n is the number of parts cut along one edge.

questions.questionText: If the height of a cone is tripled and the radius is halved, how does the volume change?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि किसी शंकु की ऊँचाई तीन गुनी कर दी जाए तथा त्रिज्या आधी कर दी जाए, तो आयतन में क्या परिवर्तन होगा?

options.textHi: मूल का तीन-चौथाई हो जाता है
मूल का एक तिहाई हो जाता है

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The volume of a cone is directly proportional to the square of its radius and its height (V ∝ r2h).

Given the radius is halved (1/2) and the height is tripled (3).

Multiplying factor for Volume = (1/2)2 × 3

New Volume factor = 1/4 × 3 = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is three-fourths of the original.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

⇒ Original radius = r, Original height = h

⇒ New radius = r/2, New height = 3h

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Volume of a cone (V) = 1/3 × πr2h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Volume (V1) = 1/3 × π × r2 × h

⇒ New Volume (V2) = 1/3 × π × (r/2)2 × (3h)

⇒ V2 = 1/3 × π × (r2 / 4) × 3h

⇒ V2 = 3/4 × (1/3 × π × r2 × h)

⇒ V2 = 3/4 × V1

**∴ The correct answer is three-fourths of the original.**

**Additional Information**

Curved Surface Area of a Cone

CSA = πrl, where l is the slant height and is calculated as l = √(r2 + h2).

Total Surface Area of a Cone

TSA = πr(r + l), combining the area of the circular base and the curved surface area.

Volume of a Cylinder

A cylinder with the same base radius and height as a cone has exactly 3 times the volume. The formula is V = πr2h.

questions.questionText: If sin θ = 12/13, and θ ∈ (0, π/2), then what is the value of tan θ?
questions.questionTextHi: sin θ = 12/13 है, और θ ∈ (0, π/2) है, तो tan θ का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The standard Pythagorean triplet for a right-angled triangle is (5, 12, 13).

Given sin θ = 12/13, we identify Perpendicular = 12 and Hypotenuse = 13.

Using the triplet, the Base is directly found to be 5.

tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base = 12/5.

Since θ is in the 1st quadrant, the ratio is positive.

**∴ The correct answer is 12/5.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

sin θ = 12/13

θ ∈ (0, π/2)

**Formula Used:**

sin θ = Perpendicular (P) ÷ Hypotenuse (H)

Base (B) = √(H2 − P2)

tan θ = Perpendicular (P) ÷ Base (B)

θ
H = 13
P = 12
B = 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let P = 12 and H = 13

⇒ B = √(132 − 122)

⇒ B = √(169 − 144)

⇒ B = √25

⇒ B = 5

⇒ tan θ = P ÷ B

⇒ tan θ = 12/5

Since θ lies in the first quadrant, all trigonometric functions are positive.

**∴ The correct answer is 12/5.**

**Additional Information**

Pythagorean Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides (H2 = P2 + B2).

Trigonometric Ratios

The primary trigonometric ratios are defined as sin θ = P/H, cos θ = B/H, and tan θ = P/B.

Quadrant Sign Rule (ASTC)

In the 1st quadrant (0 to π/2), all trigonometric ratios are positive. The ASTC rule (All, Sin, Tan, Cos) applies sequentially to the four quadrants.

questions.questionText: What is the value of tanA + cotA if tanA = 2?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि tanA = 2 है तो tanA + cotA का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Given tanA = 2.

We know that cotA is the reciprocal of tanA, so cotA = 1/2.

Now, tanA + cotA = 2 + 1/2

⇒ (4 + 1) / 2 = 5/2

**∴ The correct answer is 5/2.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

tanA = 2

**Formula Used:**

cotA = 1 / tanA

**Calculations:**

⇒ cotA = 1 / 2

⇒ tanA + cotA = 2 + 1/2

⇒ tanA + cotA = (4 + 1) / 2

⇒ tanA + cotA = 5/2

**∴ The correct answer is 5/2.**

**Additional Information**

Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities

tanθ and cotθ are reciprocals of each other. Therefore, tanθ × cotθ = 1.

Quotient Identities

tanθ = sinθ ÷ cosθ and cotθ = cosθ ÷ sinθ.

Pythagorean Identities

1 + tan2θ = sec2θ and 1 + cot2θ = cosec2θ.

questions.questionText: What is the slope of the line 2x + 3y = 6?
questions.questionTextHi: रेखा 2x + 3y = 6 की प्रवणता क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For any linear equation given in the standard form Ax + By = C, the slope of the line can be directly calculated as −A ÷ B.

Here, the given equation is 2x + 3y = 6.

Comparing it with Ax + By = C, we clearly get A = 2 and B = 3.

Slope = −A ÷ B = −2 ÷ 3 = −2/3.

**∴ The correct answer is −2/3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

The equation of the straight line is: 2x + 3y = 6

**Formula Used:**

The slope-intercept form of a linear equation is y = mx + c, where 'm' represents the slope of the line and 'c' represents the y-intercept.

Run = +3
Rise = −2

2x + 3y = 6

(0, 2)

(3, 0)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2x + 3y = 6

⇒ Transpose 2x to the right-hand side:

⇒ 3y = −2x + 6

⇒ Divide the entire equation by 3 to isolate y:

⇒ y = (−2/3)x + (6/3)

⇒ y = (−2/3)x + 2

⇒ Comparing this final equation with y = mx + c, we can identify that the slope m is −2/3.

**∴ The correct answer is −2/3.**

**Additional Information**

Slope from General Form

When a straight line is defined algebraically as Ax + By + C = 0, its constant slope can be rapidly determined using the ratio formula m = −A ÷ B.

Slope-Intercept Form y = mx + c

This specific arrangement cleanly maps line properties directly: 'm' dictates line steepness and direction (slope), while 'c' pinpoints exactly where the line crosses the y-axis.

Slope Formula Using Two Points

If a straight line passes through any two unique points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), the standard formula for its slope is evaluated as m = (y2 − y1) ÷ (x2 − x1), representing standard "rise over run".

Parallel and Perpendicular Characteristics

Lines that are purely parallel will inherently have identically equal slopes (m1 = m2). Lines intersecting at exactly 90 degrees possess completely negative reciprocal slopes (m1 × m2 = −1).

जब एक सीधी रेखा को बीजगणितीय रूप से Ax + By + C = 0 के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है, तो इसकी स्थिर ढलान को अनुपात सूत्र m = −A ÷ B का उपयोग करके तेज़ी से निर्धारित किया जा सकता है।

Slope-Intercept Form y = mx + c

यह विशिष्ट व्यवस्था रेखा के गुणों को सीधे दर्शाती है: 'm' रेखा की प्रवणता और दिशा (ढलान) को निर्धारित करता है, जबकि 'c' ठीक वहीं इंगित करता है जहां रेखा y-अक्ष को काटती है।

Slope Formula Using Two Points

यदि एक सीधी रेखा किन्हीं दो अद्वितीय बिंदुओं (x1, y1) और (x2, y2) से होकर गुजरती है, तो इसके ढलान के लिए मानक सूत्र m = (y2 − y1) ÷ (x2 − x1) के रूप में मूल्यांकन किया जाता है, जो मानक "उदय बटा क्षैतिज दूरी" को दर्शाता है।

Parallel and Perpendicular Characteristics

पूरी तरह से समानांतर रेखाओं का ढलान स्वाभाविक रूप से समान होगा (m1 = m2)। ठीक 90 डिग्री पर प्रतिच्छेद करने वाली रेखाओं का ढलान पूरी तरह से ऋणात्मक व्युत्क्रम होता है (m1 x m2 = −1)।

questions.questionText: A sector of a circle has a central angle of 60° and a radius of 8 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of π/3 radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
questions.questionTextHi: एक वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण 60° और त्रिज्या 8 सेमी है। उसी वृत्त के एक अन्य त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण π/3 रेडियन है। पहले त्रिज्यखंड के क्षेत्रफल और दूसरे त्रिज्यखंड के क्षेत्रफल का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For a given circle, the area of a sector is directly proportional to its central angle.

Central angle of the first sector = 60°.

Central angle of the second sector = π/3 radians = (180° ÷ 3) = 60°.

Since both sectors have the exact same radius and central angle, their areas are identically equal.

Ratio of their areas = 60° : 60° = 1 : 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1:1.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Radius of the circle (r) = 8 cm

Central angle of the first sector (θ1) = 60°

Central angle of the second sector (θ2) = π/3 radians

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr2

60°
8 cm
Sector 1

π/3 rad
8 cm
Sector 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of first sector (A1) = (θ1 ÷ 360°) × πr2

⇒ A1 = (60° ÷ 360°) × π × (8)2 = (1 ÷ 6) × 64π = 32π ÷ 3 cm2

⇒ To find A2, we can convert θ2 to degrees = π/3 × (180° ÷ π) = 60°

⇒ A2 = (60° ÷ 360°) × π × (8)2 = 32π ÷ 3 cm2

⇒ Alternatively using radian formula for A2 = (1 ÷ 2) × r2 × θ2

⇒ A2 = (1 ÷ 2) × (8)2 × (π ÷ 3) = 32π ÷ 3 cm2

⇒ Ratio of their areas = A1 : A2

⇒ Ratio = (32π ÷ 3) : (32π ÷ 3) = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1:1.**

**Additional Information**

Area of a Sector in Radians

If the central angle θ is given in radians, the area can be calculated directly using the formula: Area = (1 ÷ 2) × r2 × θ.

Radian to Degree Conversion

To convert an angle from radians to degrees, multiply by (180° ÷ π). Therefore, π radians is exactly equivalent to 180°.

Length of an Arc

The length of the arc of a sector with central angle θ in degrees is calculated as: L = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Shortcut Trick
किसी दिए गए वृत्त के लिए, एक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल उसके केंद्रीय कोण के सीधे आनुपातिक होता है।

questions.questionText: A triangle can have:
questions.questionTextHi: एक त्रिभुज में हो सकता है:

options.text: One obtuse angle and one right angle
options.textHi: एक अधिक कोण और एक समकोण

options.text: Only one right or one obtuse angle
options.textHi: केवल एक समकोण या एक अधिक कोण

options.text: Three acute angles each measuring more than 60°
options.textHi: तीन न्यून कोण जिनमें से प्रत्येक का माप 60° से अधिक हो

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The sum of all three interior angles of a triangle is always exactly 180°.

A triangle cannot have two right angles (90° + 90° = 180°) as the third angle would be 0°.

Similarly, having one right angle and one obtuse angle (>90°) would exceed the maximum sum of 180°.

Therefore, a valid triangle can have at most one right angle or one obtuse angle, with the remaining two angles strictly acute.

**∴ The correct answer is Only one right or one obtuse angle.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

A closed polygon with three sides and three interior angles.

**Formula Used:**

Angle Sum Property of a Triangle: Sum of all three interior angles = 180°

Angle Sum Property: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

Right Angled

Obtuse Angled
>90°

Acute Angled

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the three interior angles of the triangle be ∠A, ∠B, and ∠C.

⇒ According to the angle sum property: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°.

⇒ Checking Option 1 (Two right angles): If ∠A = 90° and ∠B = 90°, then 90° + 90° + ∠C = 180° ⇒ ∠C = 0°. This cannot form a closed triangle.

⇒ Checking Option 2 (One obtuse, one right): If ∠A > 90° and ∠B = 90°, then ∠A + ∠B > 180°. The sum exceeds 180° before even adding ∠C, which is impossible.

⇒ Checking Option 4 (Three angles > 60°): If ∠A > 60°, ∠B > 60°, and ∠C > 60°, then ∠A + ∠B + ∠C > 180°. This violates the angle sum property.

⇒ Checking Option 3 (Only one right or one obtuse angle): If ∠A = 90° or ∠A > 90°, the remaining sum for (∠B + ∠C) is exactly 90° or strictly less than 90°. Thus, the other two angles must both be acute, which perfectly satisfies the 180° property.

**∴ The correct answer is Only one right or one obtuse angle.**

**Additional Information**

Acute Angled Triangle

A triangle in which all three interior angles are strictly less than 90°. For example, an equilateral triangle has all angles as 60°.

Right Angled Triangle

A triangle containing exactly one right angle (90°). The side opposite to the right angle is the hypotenuse, following Pythagoras theorem: a2 + b2 = c2.

Obtuse Angled Triangle

A triangle in which exactly one of the interior angles is strictly greater than 90°. The sum of the remaining two angles is always less than 90°.

Exterior Angle Property

The measure of any exterior angle of a triangle is always equal to the sum of the measures of its two remote (non-adjacent) interior angles.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
एक त्रिभुज के सभी तीनों आंतरिक कोणों का योग हमेशा ठीक 180° होता है।

एक त्रिभुज में दो समकोण (90° + 90° = 180°) नहीं हो सकते क्योंकि तीसरा कोण 0° होगा।

इसी प्रकार, एक समकोण और एक अधिक कोण (>90°) होने पर अधिकतम योग 180° से अधिक हो जाएगा।

इसलिए, एक वैध त्रिभुज में अधिकतम एक समकोण या एक अधिक कोण हो सकता है, जिसमें शेष दो कोण सख्ती से न्यून कोण होते हैं।

**∴ सही उत्तर केवल एक समकोण या एक अधिक कोण है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

तीन भुजाओं और तीन आंतरिक कोणों वाला एक बंद बहुभुज।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

त्रिभुज का कोण योग गुणधर्म: सभी तीनों आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 180°

  कोण योग गुणधर्म: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

  
  
  समकोण

  
  
  अधिक कोण
  >90°

  
  न्यून कोण

**गणना:**

⇒ माना त्रिभुज के तीन आंतरिक कोण ∠A, ∠B और ∠C हैं।

⇒ कोण योग गुणधर्म के अनुसार: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°।

⇒ विकल्प 1 (दो समकोण) की जाँच: यदि ∠A = 90° और ∠B = 90°, तो 90° + 90° + ∠C = 180° ⇒ ∠C = 0°। इससे एक बंद त्रिभुज नहीं बन सकता।

⇒ विकल्प 2 (एक अधिक कोण, एक समकोण) की जाँच: यदि ∠A > 90° और ∠B = 90°, तो ∠A + ∠B > 180°। योग 180° से अधिक हो जाता है, ∠C को जोड़ने से पहले भी, जो असंभव है।

⇒ विकल्प 4 (तीन कोण > 60°) की जाँच: यदि ∠A > 60°, ∠B > 60° और ∠C > 60°, तो ∠A + ∠B + ∠C > 180°। यह कोण योग गुणधर्म का उल्लंघन करता है।

⇒ विकल्प 3 (केवल एक समकोण या एक अधिक कोण) की जाँच: यदि ∠A = 90° या ∠A > 90°, तो (∠B + ∠C) के लिए शेष योग ठीक 90° या 90° से सख्ती से कम होता है। इस प्रकार, अन्य दो कोणों को दोनों को न्यून कोण होना चाहिए, जो 180° गुणधर्म को पूरी तरह से संतुष्ट करता है।

**∴ सही उत्तर केवल एक समकोण या एक अधिक कोण है।**

**Additional Information**

न्यून कोण त्रिभुज

एक त्रिभुज जिसमें सभी तीनों आंतरिक कोण सख्ती से 90° से कम होते हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, एक समबाहु त्रिभुज के सभी कोण 60° होते हैं।

समकोण त्रिभुज

एक त्रिभुज जिसमें ठीक एक समकोण (90°) होता है। समकोण के विपरीत भुजा कर्ण होती है, जो पाइथागोरस प्रमेय का अनुसरण करती है: a2 + b2 = c2।

अधिक कोण त्रिभुज

एक त्रिभुज जिसमें ठीक एक आंतरिक कोण 90° से सख्ती से अधिक होता है। शेष दो कोणों का योग हमेशा 90° से कम होता है।

बाह्य कोण गुणधर्म

एक त्रिभुज के किसी भी बाह्य कोण का माप हमेशा उसके दो दूरस्थ (गैर-आसन्न) आंतरिक कोणों के मापों के योग के बराबर होता है।

questions.questionText: A line L is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment connecting points A(2, 5) and B(8, -1). What is the y-intercept of line L?
questions.questionTextHi: एक रेखा L, बिंदुओं A(2, 5) और B(8, -1) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखंड का लंब समद्विभाजक है। रेखा L का y-अंत:खंड क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Midpoint of AB = ((2 + 8) ÷ 2, (5 − 1) ÷ 2) = (5, 2).

Slope of AB = (−1 − 5) ÷ (8 − 2) = −1, so the slope of its perpendicular bisector is 1.

Using the equation y = mx + c for the bisector passing through (5, 2):

2 = 1 × 5 + c ⇒ c = −3.

**∴ The correct answer is −3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Points A(2, 5) and B(8, −1)

Line L is the perpendicular bisector of segment AB.

**Formulas Used:**

Midpoint = ((x1 + x2) ÷ 2, (y1 + y2) ÷ 2)

Slope m = (y2 − y1) ÷ (x2 − x1)

Point-slope equation: y − y1 = m × (x − x1)

Y

A(2, 5)
B(8, -1)
M(5, 2)
(0, -3)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Midpoint of AB, M = ((2 + 8) ÷ 2, (5 − 1) ÷ 2)

⇒ M = (10 ÷ 2, 4 ÷ 2) = (5, 2)

⇒ Slope of line segment AB, mAB = (−1 − 5) ÷ (8 − 2)

⇒ mAB = −6 ÷ 6 = −1

⇒ Since line L is perpendicular to AB, its slope mL = −1 ÷ mAB

⇒ mL = −1 ÷ (−1) = 1

⇒ Equation of line L passing through M(5, 2) with slope 1:

⇒ y − y1 = mL × (x − x1)

⇒ y − 2 = 1 × (x − 5)

⇒ y = x − 5 + 2

⇒ y = x − 3

⇒ To find the y-intercept, set x = 0:

⇒ y = 0 − 3 = −3

**∴ The correct answer is −3.**

**Additional Information**

Midpoint Formula

The coordinates of the midpoint of a line segment connecting (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) are given by ((x1 + x2) ÷ 2, (y1 + y2) ÷ 2).

Slope of Perpendicular Lines

If two lines are perpendicular to each other, the product of their slopes is always −1 (m1 × m2 = −1).

Equation of a Line

The slope-intercept form is y = mx + c, where m is the slope and c is the y-intercept (the point where the line crosses the y-axis).

लंबवत रेखाओं की ढलान

questions.questionText: The area of a triangle ABC is 16 cm². If a similar triangle DEF has sides that are twice the length of ΔABC's sides, what is the area of ΔDEF?
questions.questionTextHi: एक त्रिभुज ABC का क्षेत्रफल 16 वर्ग सेमी है। यदि एक समरूप त्रिभुज DEF की भुजाएँ ΔABC की भुजाओं की दोगुनी हैं, तो ΔDEF का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is strictly equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Given the side ratio (DEF to ABC) is 2 : 1.

Area ratio = (2)2 : (1)2 = 4 : 1

Area of ΔDEF = 4 × Area of ΔABC

Area of ΔDEF = 4 × 16 = 64 cm2

**∴ The correct answer is 64 cm2.**

**Alternate Method**

**Additional Information**

Similarity Area Theorem

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is strictly equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians. Formula: Area1 / Area2 = (S1 / S2)2.

Perimeter of Similar Triangles

Unlike area, the ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is directly proportional to the ratio of their corresponding sides without any squaring. Formula: P1 / P2 = S1 / S2.

Congruent vs Similar

Congruent triangles are identical in both shape and size (Area ratio is exactly 1:1), while similar triangles have the same shape but may differ in size depending on the scale factor.

questions.questionText: 44³ + 35³ - 53³ + 159 is equal to:
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Using the Digital Root (DR) method:

DR of 443 = 83 = 512 ⇒ 8

DR of 353 = 83 = 512 ⇒ 8

DR of 533 = 83 = 512 ⇒ 8, and DR of 159 = 1 + 5 + 9 = 15 ⇒ 6

Expression DR = 8 + 8 − 8 + 6 = 14 ⇒ 5

Checking options, DR of −20659 is 9 − (2 + 0 + 6 + 5 + 9) = 9 − 22 ⇒ 9 − 4 = 5. (Matches perfectly)

**∴ The correct answer is -20659.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

443 + 353 − 533 + 159

**Calculations:**

First, calculate the cube of each number:

⇒ 443 = 44 × 44 × 44 = 85184

⇒ 353 = 35 × 35 × 35 = 42875

⇒ 533 = 53 × 53 × 53 = 148877

Substitute the values back into the expression:

⇒ 85184 + 42875 − 148877 + 159

Summing the positive numbers:

⇒ (85184 + 42875 + 159) − 148877

⇒ 128218 − 148877

Subtracting the larger value from the smaller value:

⇒ −20659

**∴ The correct answer is -20659.**

**Additional Information**

BODMAS Rule

Simplification strictly follows the BODMAS sequence: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Digital Root Method

The sum of the digits of a number until a single digit is obtained. It serves as an excellent shortcut to verify large calculations without doing the actual arithmetic.

Digital Root for Negative Numbers

If an algebraic calculation involves negative final roots, you find the positive single digit form by subtracting its absolute digital root from 9.

questions.questionText: If sinA + cosA = \(\frac{5}{4}\), find sin2A.
questions.questionTextHi: यदि sinA + cosA = \(\frac{5}{4}\) है, तो sin2A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Given, sinA + cosA = 5/4

Square both sides directly to use the relation (sinA + cosA)2 = 1 + sin2A.

1 + sin2A = (5/4)2 = 25/16

sin2A = 25/16 − 1 = 9/16

**∴ The correct answer is 9/16.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

sinA + cosA = 5/4

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

sin2A + cos2A = 1

sin2A = 2sinAcosA

**Calculation:**

⇒ sinA + cosA = 5/4

Squaring both sides,

⇒ (sinA + cosA)2 = (5/4)2

⇒ sin2A + cos2A + 2sinAcosA = 25/16

Substitute sin2A + cos2A = 1 and 2sinAcosA = sin2A,

⇒ 1 + sin2A = 25/16

⇒ sin2A = 25/16 − 1

⇒ sin2A = (25 − 16) / 16

⇒ sin2A = 9/16

**∴ The correct answer is 9/16.**

**Additional Information**

Trigonometric Identities

The fundamental Pythagorean identity states that sin2A + cos2A = 1 for any angle A.

Double Angle Formula

The double angle formula for sine is sin2A = 2sinAcosA. Other common variations include cos2A = cos2A − sin2A.

Difference Identity

Similarly, squaring the difference gives the relation (sinA − cosA)2 = 1 − 2sinAcosA = 1 − sin2A.

1 + sin2A = (5/4)2 = 25/16

sin2A = 25/16 − 1 = 9/16

**∴ सही उत्तर 9/16 है।**

**Alternate Method**

**गणना:**

⇒ sinA + cosA = 5/4

दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर,

⇒ (sinA + cosA)2 = (5/4)2

⇒ sin2A + cos2A + 2sinAcosA = 25/16

sin2A + cos2A = 1 और 2sinAcosA = sin2A प्रतिस्थापित करने पर,

⇒ 1 + sin2A = 25/16

⇒ sin2A = 9/16

**∴ सही उत्तर 9/16 है।**

**Additional Information**

त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिकाएँ

मौलिक पाइथागोरस सर्वसमिका यह बताती है कि किसी भी कोण A के लिए sin2A + cos2A = 1 होता है।

दुगुना कोण सूत्र

साइन के लिए दुगुना कोण सूत्र sin2A = 2sinAcosA है। अन्य सामान्य भिन्नताओं में cos2A = cos2A − sin2A शामिल है।

अंतर सर्वसमिका

इसी तरह, अंतर का वर्ग करने पर संबंध (sinA − cosA)2 = 1 − 2sinAcosA = 1 − sin2A प्राप्त होता है।

questions.questionText: From an outside point P, two tangents, PA and PB, are drawn to a circle. Given that the length of PA is 12 cm, what is the length of PB?
questions.questionTextHi: एक बाह्य बिंदु P से एक वृत्त पर दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PA और PB खींची गई हैं। PA की लंबाई 12 सेमी है, तो PB की लंबाई क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
According to the tangent property of a circle, the lengths of two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are always equal.

⇒ Length of Tangent PA = Length of Tangent PB

⇒ PB = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Length of tangent PA = 12 cm.

PA and PB are tangents from an external point P to a circle with center O.

**Concept Used:**

A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius drawn to the point of tangency. By proving the two triangles formed by the tangents, radii, and the line connecting the external point to the center are congruent, we can establish that the tangent lengths are equal.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Consider △OAP and △OBP:

⇒ OA = OB (Radii of the same circle)

⇒ OP = OP (Common hypotenuse)

⇒ ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90° (Tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact)

⇒ By RHS (Right angle - Hypotenuse - Side) congruence criterion, △OAP ≅ △OBP.

⇒ Therefore, PA = PB (Corresponding parts of congruent triangles)

⇒ Since PA = 12 cm, it follows that PB = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**Additional Information**

Direct Common Tangent (DCT)

When two circles do not intersect, the length of their direct common tangent is given by √(d2 − (R − r)2), where d is the distance between their centers and R, r are their radii.

Transverse Common Tangent (TCT)

The length of the transverse common tangent (which crosses the line segment joining the centers) is calculated using the formula √(d2 − (R + r)2).

Tangent-Secant Theorem

If a tangent segment and a secant segment are drawn to a circle from an exterior point, the square of the length of the tangent is equal to the product of the external secant part and the entire secant length (PT2 = PA × PB).

Number of Tangents Rule

From an external point, exactly two tangents can be drawn to a circle. From a point on the circle, exactly one tangent can be drawn, and from a point inside the circle, zero tangents can be drawn.

वृत्त की एक स्पर्शरेखा स्पर्शरेखा के बिंदु पर खींची गई त्रिज्या के लंबवत होती है। स्पर्शरेखाओं, त्रिज्याओं और बाहरी बिंदु को केंद्र से जोड़ने वाली रेखा द्वारा निर्मित दो त्रिभुजों को सर्वांगसम सिद्ध करके, हम स्थापित कर सकते हैं कि स्पर्शरेखा की लंबाई बराबर होती है।

Transverse Common Tangent (TCT)

अनुप्रस्थ उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्शरेखा (जो केंद्रों को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखंड को पार करती है) की लंबाई √(d2 − (R + r)2) सूत्र का उपयोग करके गणना की जाती है।

Tangent-Secant Theorem

यदि एक स्पर्शरेखा खंड और एक छेदक खंड एक बाहरी बिंदु से एक वृत्त पर खींचे जाते हैं, तो स्पर्शरेखा की लंबाई का वर्ग बाहरी छेदक भाग और पूरी छेदक लंबाई के गुणनफल के बराबर होता है (PT2 = PA x PB)।

Number of Tangents Rule

एक बाहरी बिंदु से, एक वृत्त पर ठीक दो स्पर्शरेखाएँ खींची जा सकती हैं। वृत्त पर एक बिंदु से, ठीक एक स्पर्शरेखा खींची जा सकती है, और वृत्त के अंदर एक बिंदु से, शून्य स्पर्शरेखाएँ खींची जा सकती हैं।

Shortcut Trick
For a right-angled triangle, the inradius (r) is calculated directly by:

**r = (Perpendicular + Base − Hypotenuse) ÷ 2**

Hypotenuse = √(62 + 82) = √100 = 10 cm

r = (6 + 8 − 10) ÷ 2 = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2 cm.**

Height (p) = 6 cm

Inradius (r) = Area ÷ s

**Additional Information**

समकोण त्रिभुज के लिए, अंतःत्रिज्या (r) की गणना सीधे इस प्रकार की जाती है:

**r = (लम्ब + आधार − कर्ण) ÷ 2**

कर्ण = √(62 + 82) = √100 = 10 cm

r = (6 + 8 − 10) ÷ 2 = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 cm

**∴ सही उत्तर 2 cm है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

आधार (b) = 8 cm

ऊँचाई (p) = 6 cm

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 x आधार x ऊँचाई

अर्ध-परिमाप (s) = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

अंतःत्रिज्या (r) = क्षेत्रफल ÷ s

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  8 cm
  6 cm
  10 cm
  
  r
  r
  r

**गणनाएँ:**

⇒ c = √(62 + 82) = √(36 + 64) = 10 cm

⇒ क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 x 8 x 6 = 24 cm2

⇒ s = (6 + 8 + 10) ÷ 2 = 12 cm

⇒ r = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 cm

**∴ सही उत्तर 2 cm है।**

**Additional Information**

समबाहु त्रिभुज की अंतःत्रिज्या

सूत्र: r = a ÷ (2√3), जहाँ a भुजा की लंबाई है।

समकोण त्रिभुज की परित्रिज्या

R = कर्ण ÷ 2। परिकेन्द्र स्वाभाविक रूप से कर्ण के ठीक मध्य बिंदु पर स्थित होता है।

सामान्य अंतःत्रिज्या सूत्र

r = Δ ÷ s, सभी त्रिभुजों पर बिना किसी अपवाद के लागू होता है, जहाँ Δ क्षेत्रफल है और s अर्ध-परिमाप है।

पाइथागोरस त्रिक

समकोण त्रिभुजों के सामान्य पूर्णांक भुजाओं को याद रखने के लिए (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), और (8, 15, 17) शामिल हैं।

questions.questionText: If a = 0.02, b = 0.03, c = -0.05, and a + b + c = 0, find (a³ + b³ + c³) ÷ (3abc)
questions.questionTextHi: यदि a = 0.02, b = 0.03, c = -0.05, तथा a + b + c = 0 है, तो (a³ + b³ + c³) ÷ (3abc) ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For any real numbers, if a + b + c = 0, then a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

Given expression: (a3 + b3 + c3) ÷ (3abc)

Substitute a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc directly into the numerator.

⇒ 3abc ÷ 3abc = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

a = 0.02

b = 0.03

c = −0.05

a + b + c = 0

**Formula Used:**

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca)

**Calculations:**

⇒ We are given that a + b + c = 0.

⇒ Substitute this value into the standard formula.

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 0 × (a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca)

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 0

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc

We need to find the value of (a3 + b3 + c3) ÷ (3abc)

⇒ Substitute the derived value of a3 + b3 + c3 into the given expression.

⇒ (3abc) ÷ (3abc) = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

**Additional Information**

Standard Algebraic Identity

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca)

Alternative Form

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [(a − b)2 + (b − c)2 + (c − a)2]

Conditional Identity

If a + b + c = 0, or if a = b = c, then a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

questions.questionText: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **LUMINOUS**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Radiant**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Luminous"** refers to something that emits or reflects light; it is bright or shining, especially in the dark. (प्रकाशमान, चमकीला)

**Example:** The luminous stars lit up the night sky beautifully.

**"Radiant"** means emitting rays of light or shining brightly, which makes it synonymous with "luminous." (दीप्तिमान, चमकदार)

**Example:** Her radiant smile lit up the entire room.

Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **'Luminous'** is **'Radiant.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Radiant**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Dull** (मंद, फीका): Lacking brightness or vividness; not shiny.

**Example:** The dull surface of the old mirror reflected very little light.

**Dim** (धुंधला): Not bright or clear; lacking in light.

**Example:** The room appeared dim as the lamp’s light was very weak.

**Opaque** (अस्पष्ट, अपारदर्शी): Not transparent or translucent; not allowing light to pass through.

**Example:** The opaque glass window blocked the sunlight completely.

questions.questionText: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **EXIGUOUS**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Scanty**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Exiguous"** means something that is very small in size or quantity, or insufficient. (अत्यल्प)

**Example:** The company’s exiguous profits barely covered their operating expenses.

**"Scanty"** refers to something that is insufficient or meager in amount or size. (अल्प)

**Example:** The scanty rainfall this year has led to drought conditions in the region.

Hence, the synonym for **"Exiguous"** is **"Scanty"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Scanty**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Huge** (विशाल): Very large in size, extent, or amount.

**Example:** The statue was so huge that it could be seen from miles away.

**Excessive** (अत्यधिक): More than what is necessary, normal, or desirable.

**Example:** The excessive use of fertilizers can harm the soil quality.

**Abundant** (प्रचुर): Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.

**Example:** The forest is abundant with wildlife and natural beauty.

questions.questionText: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Abrogate**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Uphold**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Abrogate"** means to repeal or do away with a law, right, or formal agreement. (रद्द करना)

**Example:** The government decided to abrogate the outdated law that hindered economic growth.

**"Uphold"** refers to maintaining or supporting something, particularly laws or principles, without letting them be repealed or discarded. (संरक्षित करना)

**Example:** The court upheld the decision to protect the environment from industrial pollution.

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abrogate'** is **'Uphold'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Abolish** (समाप्त करना): To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution.

**Example:** The government abolished the old tax regime to simplify the process for taxpayers.

**Revoke** (रद्द करना): To officially cancel or withdraw something, such as a law, order, or privilege.

**Example:** His driving license was revoked after the court found him guilty of reckless driving.

**Annul** (निरस्त करना): To declare something invalid, such as a law or agreement, often legally.

**Example:** The marriage was annulled due to legal discrepancies in the documentation.

questions.questionText:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**To chew the cud of reflection**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Pondering deeply)**.

**Key Points**

The idiom **"To chew the cud of reflection"** means to think deeply or meditate over something. It originates from the behavior of cows chewing cud, which metaphorically represents careful and prolonged consideration. (किसी चीज़ पर गहराई से सोचना)

**Example:** After hearing the news, she sat by the window and chewed the cud of reflection, wondering what to do next.

To "ponder deeply" refers to careful thought or contemplation, often before making a decision or forming an opinion. (गहराई से विचार करना)

**Example:** He pondered deeply about the consequences of his actions before making a final decision.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Pondering deeply)**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Option 1: Eating slowly** (धीरे-धीरे खाना): This simply refers to consuming food at a slow pace.

**Example:** She enjoys eating slowly to savor every bite of her meal.

**Option 2: Daydreaming without focus** (ध्यान केंद्रित किए बिना कल्पना करना): This refers to indulging in aimless thoughts or fantasies.

**Example:** He spent the afternoon daydreaming without focus, staring out of the window.

**Option 4: Mentally preparing for battle** (युद्ध के लिए मानसिक रूप से तैयारी करना): This indicates getting ready for a challenging situation, often involving mental preparation.

**Example:** Before the debate, she spent hours mentally preparing for battle against her opponent.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A person who supports change'.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Reformer**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Reformer"** refers to a person who works to bring about positive changes in society, systems, or institutions. They aim to improve the existing conditions by introducing reforms. (सुधारक)

**Example:** Mahatma Gandhi was a great reformer who advocated for non-violence and social change.

In this context, the term describes someone who actively supports change for the betterment of the system or society.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reformer**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Conservative** (रूढ़िवादी): Refers to a person who is resistant to change and prefers to maintain traditional values and practices.

**Example:** He is a conservative who opposes any reforms in the educational system.

**Radical** (उग्रवादी): Refers to someone who advocates for thorough or complete political or social change, often through revolutionary means.

**Example:** The radical leaders demanded immediate and drastic changes in the government policies.

**Constitutionalist** (संवैधानिकवादी): Refers to a person who supports or adheres to the principles of a constitution, particularly a written one.

**Example:** As a constitutionalist, he always emphasizes the importance of rule of law in governance.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct** one-word substitute** for: 'Extremely old-fashioned; belonging to a time before the biblical flood'.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Antediluvian**.

**Key Points**

The word **"Antediluvian"** means extremely old-fashioned or outdated; it refers to something that existed before the biblical flood. (पुरातन)

**Example: **Her ideas about gender roles are so antediluvian that they seem out of place in the modern world.

**"Antediluvian"** is derived from the Latin words "ante" (before) and "diluvium" (flood), meaning before the flood. (बाढ़ से पहले का)

**Example: **The antediluvian artifacts found in the excavation site amazed the archaeologists.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Antediluvian**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

**Tale** (कहानी): A story, especially one that is imaginative or fictitious.

**Example:** The children were captivated by the tale of the brave knight and the dragon.

**Obsolete** (प्राचीन या अप्रचलित): No longer in use or outdated.

**Example:** Typewriters have become obsolete in the age of computers.

**Medieval** (मध्यकालीन): Relating to the Middle Ages, roughly the period from the 5th to the late 15th century.

**Example:** The medieval castle stood tall as a reminder of the region's rich history.

The correct answer is '**disregarded**'.

**Key Points**

The anthropologist's findings were considered controversial, which suggests that they were not immediately accepted.
The word "**disregarded**" fits this context as it means "ignored" or "not given importance."
Options 2 ("celebrated"), 3 ("acclaimed"), and 4 ("adopted") imply positive reception, which contradicts the idea of controversy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"The anthropologist's findings were considered so controversial that they were initially **disregarded**."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 2: "celebrated"** is incorrect because controversial findings are unlikely to be celebrated immediately.
**Option 3: "acclaimed"** is incorrect because acclaim typically follows widespread acceptance, not controversy.
**Option 4: "adopted"** is incorrect because adopting something implies approval, which contradicts the initial controversy.

questions.questionText:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

The draft policy outlines (1)/ that each employee must adhere to (2)/ the code of conduct (3)/ irrespective of their position. (4)/
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Key Points**

The error lies in the use of "**their**" in part 4 of the sentence.
The pronoun "**their**" is plural, but the subject "**each employee**" is singular.
To maintain grammatical consistency, the singular pronoun "**his or her**" should be used instead of "**their**."
Thus, the correct phrase should be "**irrespective of his or her position.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The draft policy outlines that each employee must adhere to the code of conduct irrespective of **his or her** position."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1:** "The draft policy outlines" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
**Option 2:** "that each employee must adhere to" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
**Option 3:** "the code of conduct" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

questions.questionText:
Change the following from active to passive:
They were showing the movie at 7 pm.

options.text: The movie is shown at 7 pm.
The movie was shown at 7 pm.
The movie was being shown at 7 pm.
The movie has been shown at 7 pm.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
In the active voice, the sentence is: "They were showing the movie at 7 pm."
To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the movie" at the beginning.
Change the active verb form "were showing" to "was being shown" (past continuous passive).
Ensure the time phrase "at 7 pm" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The movie was being shown at 7 pm."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: **"The movie is shown at 7 pm." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
**Option 2: **"The movie was shown at 7 pm." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
**Option 4: **"The movie has been shown at 7 pm." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).

questions.questionText:

**Key Points**

The error lies in **part 2** of the sentence.
The phrase "so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended" is incorrect because "nor" is used incorrectly in this context.
"Nor" is generally used in negative sentences following "neither." Here, "and" would be appropriate instead of "nor."
Thus, the correct sentence should use "and" instead of "nor" to ensure grammatical accuracy and proper sentence construction.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rarely had the court encountered a petition so devoid of legal merit, and so conspicuously intended to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy."*

**Additional Information**

**Part 1:** "Rarely had the court encountered a petition" – This part is correct and does not require any changes.
**Part 3:** "to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy" – This part is also correct and does not require any changes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best reflects the Ayurvedic approach to disease?

options.text: Using synthetic drugs for immediate relief
Restoring internal bodily balance through lifestyle

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3: ****Restoring internal bodily balance through lifestyle**.

**Key Points**

Ayurveda focuses on restoring the internal balance of the body and mind, rather than targeting external pathogens or symptoms directly.
This approach involves holistic practices such as diet, exercise, meditation, and herbal remedies to enhance overall well-being.
Unlike conventional medicine, Ayurveda aims to treat the root cause of disease by addressing lifestyle and environmental factors.
Options involving antibiotics, synthetic drugs, or genetic mutation targeting reflect methods of modern medicine, not Ayurveda.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Explanation:** *Ayurveda emphasizes achieving harmony in the body through natural methods like proper nutrition, mindfulness, and herbal therapies, rather than relying on quick fixes or invasive treatments.*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1:** Eradicating bacteria via antibiotics – This reflects conventional medicine rather than Ayurveda.
**Option 2:** Using synthetic drugs for immediate relief – Ayurvedic practices do not rely on synthetic drugs but focus on long-term balance.
**Option 4:** Targeting genetic mutations – This approach is part of modern genetic research and does not align with Ayurveda's principles.

questions.questionText: According to the passage, what is required for the survival and relevance of Yoga and traditional medicine in modern India?

questions.questionText:
**A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.**

He said to me, "You should work harder."

options.text: He said me that I should work harder.
He told me that I should work harder.
He told me that you should work harder.
He told that I should work harder.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Key Points**

**Indirect Speech:** He told me that I should work harder.
**Key Conversions:**

**"You should work harder" becomes "I should work harder"**

Pronoun "You" is converted to "I" to match the perspective of the person being addressed.
Verb "should work" remains unchanged as it is modal and does not require tense changes.

**Reporting verb:**

Direct: "said to me"
Converted to: "told me," which is more appropriate for indirect speech.

**Punctuation and Format:**

Direct speech is removed and replaced with a reporting clause.
Quotation marks are omitted as the sentence is converted to indirect speech.
The sentence is structured to convey meaning without altering the original intent.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"He told me that I should work harder."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1:** "He said me that I should work harder."

Incorrect use of "said me" instead of "told me." The verb "said" must be followed by "to" when addressing someone.

**Option 3:** "He told me that you should work harder."

Incorrect pronoun "you" instead of "I," which changes the perspective of the sentence.

**Option 4:** "He told that I should work harder."

Missing the indirect object "me," which makes the sentence incomplete.

questions.questionText:
**A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.**

The diplomat said that only after the ceasefire would negotiations begin.

options.text: "Negotiations begin only after the ceasefire," said the diplomat.
"Only after the ceasefire, negotiations would begin," said the diplomat.
"Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin," said the diplomat.
"Negotiations would begin once the ceasefire is announced," said the diplomat.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

**Indirect Speech:** The diplomat said that only after the ceasefire would negotiations begin.
**Key Conversions:**

**"only after the ceasefire would negotiations begin" becomes "Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin"**

The structure of the sentence is maintained, with the modal verb "would" in indirect speech converted to "will" in direct speech.
The position of "only after the ceasefire" is unchanged to preserve the emphasis.

**Reporting verb:**

Indirect: "The diplomat said that"
Converted to: "said the diplomat" at the end of the direct speech.

**Punctuation and Format:**

Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
Starts with a capital letter "Only" and ends with a period "."
Reporting clause ("said the diplomat") follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Only after the ceasefire will negotiations begin," said the diplomat.*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1:** "Negotiations begin only after the ceasefire," said the diplomat.

Incorrect word order: "Negotiations begin only after" changes the intended emphasis.

**Option 2:** "Only after the ceasefire, negotiations would begin," said the diplomat.

Incorrect modal verb: "would" is used instead of "will," which alters the tense and meaning.

**Option 4:** "Negotiations would begin once the ceasefire is announced," said the diplomat.

Changes the structure and meaning by introducing "once the ceasefire is announced."
